chart_title: Intelligence Index vs. Cost to Run Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index
x_axis: Cost to Run Intelligence Index (USD, Log Scale)
cost_unit: USD to run all Intelligence Index evaluations

universe.selection_evidence: The public chart model selector displayed '697 of 697 models' after Select all. The total-cost chart SVG (recharts surface, 1128 px wide at a 1600 x 1200 viewport) contained 189 circles and one dotted Pareto path (stroke-dasharray '0.1 6') with 18 M/L coordinate pairs, each matching a circle centre exactly (distance 0 px).

method: Playwright (headless Chromium 1600 x 1200, repository's playwright 1.62.0; no persistent profile, no sign-in). Opened the Intelligence Index evaluation page at the eval-cost=intelligence-vs-total-cost URL (the 'Score vs. Total Cost' tab active), scrolled the chart into view, opened its model selector and chose Select all (697 of 697 models). Read every circle centre (data-chart-item-id, cx, cy, fill) and the dotted Pareto path from the chart SVG, matched each path vertex to the circle at the same coordinates, then moved the mouse to every circle centre (from a neutral position each time) and recorded the public tooltip verbatim. All 189 hovers returned a tooltip and all 189 tooltips are distinct, so no overlapped pair needed an offset hover. No embedded payload, API, export or paid data was used for the chart values; owner URLs come from AA's own catalog list ({slug, name, releaseSlug}, 707 entries) embedded in a model page, reusing the 2026-10-17 URL for every unchanged name (each slug re-verified in the current catalog).

precision.intelligence_index: Rounded integer displayed by public tooltip; raw precision is not recovered from SVG coordinates.
precision.total_cost_usd: Two decimal places displayed by public tooltip.

duplicate_resolution: None needed: at the 1600 px viewport every circle-centre hover returned a distinct tooltip (189 distinct for 189 circles). The 2026-10-17 overlapped pair (GPT-5.5 (medium) and GLM-5.2 (max)) resolved directly.

comparison_to_previous_capture.basis: Rendered Pareto path vertices matched to circles and read from public tooltips on both dates; the 18 vertices carry the same circle ids, tooltips and SVG y coordinates as on 2026-10-17 (x differs only with the viewport width). Near-frontier set: 9 -> 11 (added DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 (max) and MiniMax-M3.1-Flash, both new to the chart).

near_frontier_policy.basis: Public rounded integer Intelligence Index and two-decimal USD total cost from the chart tooltips. The frontier's intelligence at a point's cost is the highest intelligence among rendered-frontier points whose cost is at or below that cost; a point cheaper than every frontier point has no gap.
